0022600110.text: The Nuggets (0-1, 4th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, 9th in the West) host the 0-1 Pelicans (3rd in the Southwest, 1 game back, 8th in the West) in this second game of Denver's season. Julian Strawther is out with a knee sprain, and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions. Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 122-116 win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026, and no games have been played in the 2026-27 series yet.
